R3.replay: (a) A row's THREAD read hangs the run. (b) The run crashes after Started and before any row (Controls page read, or one Your call row).
quotes: actions STEP 1: 'Before starting a row, add the body line "actions: try <n> <run id>" ... a row that already has 3 gets "actions: stuck <why>" instead ... and no longer holds W'
OVERLAP: 'still says Started and is under 90 minutes old: write only this run's record as "No-op, previous run still live", change nothing else'
R3.a: CLOSED: tries at runs 1, 3 and 5 (each crash costs one No-op hour), stuck at run 7, then W is freed.
R3.b: A crash before any row writes no try. If it is deterministic, for example one Your call row that crashes STEP 0 ('first and in full, before you take any mail'), the cycle is crash, No-op, crash, No-op, forever. No mail is ever worked and Your call is never cleared. There's no try or stuck mechanism for Your call rows. It's visible in the morning check as Started records, but nothing stops it.
R3.verdict: CLOSED for mail rows; new should-fix D4 for Your call rows

A1_stamped_join.case_crash_between: Zoya logs 'Priya to Zoya: confirms 14 Nov recording' (Email in, in ad@ via Cc) at 10:40. Capture is capped or late, and actions moves W to 11:20 on capture's own newer rows (the unstamped row doesn't hold W). Capture at 12:02 stamps the row, then crashes before listing it. Next run: T is unchanged (no read to), the message is re-read, the msgid is held, and the row now HAS a capture: line, so the exception ('without a "capture:" line') skips it. Actions: created 10:40 < W-2min, not created before 2 Nov, not on any stamped: line. STEP 0 doesn't cover it after 2 Nov. LOST for good: Status never moves to Booked, and an Akshay ask answered by a chat-logged 'Akshay to ...' row stays on his list. Rare (needs a lag and a crash in a one-call window), but silent, and the fix is free.
A1_stamped_join.case_final_write_clobber: No crash needed. RUN RECORD defines the final 'page body =' as pending + report + counts and doesn't list 'stamped:'. A literal replace_content at the last write drops the line, so every late stamp of a run that completes normally is lost the same way. Replay4c S-J1 tested only the crash path.
A1_stamped_join.case_long_body: Low risk. Actions reads 'only that line' through one fetch per record. Make the line the record's first body line so a truncated fetch still has it.
A1_stamped_join.case_actions_down_over_24h: Safe. The window is anchored on W ('created since W minus 24 hours'), not on now. W doesn't move while actions is down, so records from the whole outage stay in the window.
A1_stamped_join.case_step0_stamps: STEP 0 stamps aren't listed on 'stamped:'. For rows created on or after 2 Nov (only reachable through a non-JST Captured, see R4), actions can't find them once W has passed.
